In addition to ongoing $50 discounts on AirPods Pro 3 and up to $130 off Apple Watch Series 11, today's main focus at 9to5Toys' Lunch Break is Amazon restocking select M5 MacBook Air models with $150 off, along with Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models discounted by $220 today (with more up to $449 off). We also have Siri-enabled Eve wireless HomeKit sphere lights at 25% off, the first-ever $250 discount on the all-new Bose Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and speaker set, and up to 30% off Nomad leather iPhone 17/Air cases. See details below.

Pick up new AirPods Pro 3 this summer for nearly $50 off, starting from $99 for select models

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $149 (originally $179)

Upgrade your Apple Watch this summer, Series 11 drops to $299 (all colors)

Summer is in full swing, and Apple Watch Series 11 deals are heating up too, with $100 off in cash discounts on entry-level models. Whether you're getting a summer birthday gift, a back-to-school present, or simply looking to upgrade your personal health management gear, you can save a bundle.

There might be deeper discounts later this fall, but if you want to get your hands on this generation of Apple wrist computer right now for whatever reason, there's actually plenty of room to save money.

42mm model — the most entry-level option of the Series 11 — currently on sale for $299 with free shipping. We featured this deal when it first appeared last weekend, and now Amazon has all four case colors available at this promotional price: Jet Black, Rose Gold, Silver, and Space Gray.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell starting from $399 (originally $499)

This is the current Apple Watch priced at $399, now with a direct $100 cash discount.

If you want the larger 46mm case, most (but not all) colors of the 46mm model also have $100 off the price. Also note the 46mm Cellular version below with up to $130 off:

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell starting from $399 (originally $529)

Amazon restocks select M5 MacBook Air models with $150 off the new pricing baseline

Although AirPods Pro 3 has decent deals this week, Amazon has actually struggled for the past two weeks to restock the new M5 MacBook Air at its discounted price — they're trying to undercut other retailers' prices. Apple and other retailers' suggested retail prices have been raised, but Amazon has indeed restocked several models starting this morning with $150 off.

Earlier, the 15-inch models were easier to purchase at a discount, since they offered more discount after the price increase. But today, several configurations of the more affordable 13-inch models are back in stock, with various color options available:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (originally $1,799)

After Apple announced and launched the new M5 MacBook Air lineup with price increases, we briefly saw some deals at significantly lower prices, but now it's nearly impossible to find them. If you're looking to pick up a new machine this summer, the $150 discount range is basically the sweet spot available right now.

Although Best Buy is running its Appreciation Sale this week, by comparison, all their M5 MacBook Air models are still at full price. Amazon appears to be running low on some models, but they do indeed offer several configurations below suggested retail today.

Nomad drops price again on 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger to 25% off, Cosmic Orange hits new low

Nomad's 2026 Anniversary Sale is underway this week, but they've further reduced the price of their latest 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger. This premium metal and glass charger in black and white models is now 25% off, while the new Cosmic Orange hits a new low.

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe Charger $90 (originally $129) in black or white
  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe Charger $111 (originally $139) in all-new Cosmic Orange color

The 3-in-1 25W Stand One Max still maintains its launch 20% off deal, but the deal on the 2-in-1 model looks like one of the regular daily deals Nomad currently offers — yesterday it was 20% off.

Amazon's Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models are $220 off today, more up to $449 off

We've been tracking Amazon's renewed iPhone 17 Pro deals, but the discounts on their highest quality Renewed Premium models are only just starting to look good now. The latest pricing for all three iPhone 17 Pro colors is now up to $220 off.

All the items below are sold and shipped by Amazon directly (not third-party sellers), and are Renewed Premium models — Amazon's highest quality refurbished goods, offering a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and "battery life exceeding 90%."

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (originally $1,299 new)

The biggest highlight is that the 1TB model is now $220 cheaper than Apple's direct pricing for a new unlocked 17 Pro. The 512GB model, while $100 off, might not be enough of a saving for some people to choose over a new device.

However, these are some of the best Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro deals we've tracked, but you should know Amazon currently has even cheaper refurbished units in "excellent condition" — the main difference being those come with a 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee and battery "capacity exceeding 80% of original":

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,107 (originally $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,139 (originally $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Silver $1,120 (originally $1,299 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,240 (originally $1,499 new)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,263 (originally $1,499 new)

Woot's 17 Pro Max models are up to $49 off — "PRISTINE, never opened," with "test stickers showing 100% battery life" and "a beautiful custom black gift box,"

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)

Satechi unveils all-new MacBook Neo lineup: world's "first" dual-connector docking slot, more

Satechi's anodized aluminum Slim EX wireless mouse with metal scroll wheel drops to $24

Siri-enabled Eve wireless HomeKit sphere light at Amazon 25% off (limited time, Apple sells for $100)

Eve's smart HomeKit sphere light has a significant 25% discount on Amazon today. In my opinion, it's still one of the best-looking portable lights in its class, and the price is close to this year's lowest.

Amazon now sells the Eve Flare portable smart LED light (supports Apple HomeKit) for $74.99 with free shipping. Priced at $100, it's now 75% of the suggested retail price — the best deal around.

Amazon's listing shows a price of $110, similar to the official Eve website, but the actual price is around $100, and the official Apple Store has been selling it for $100 seven days a week.

All-new Bose Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and speaker set $250 off (new low)

When Amazon previously lowered the price of a pair of all-new Alexa+/AirPlay Bose Lifestyle Ultra speakers, we already mentioned this was the first significant discount on the all-new Bose Lifestyle Ultra home speaker lineup. But today we're highlighting the Bose Surround Sound Set with nearly $250 off, which also includes the all-new Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar.

Amazon now sells the Bose Surround Sound Set for $1,449 with free shipping, including 1 Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and 1 pair of Lifestyle Ultra speakers.

If you buy all components separately, the total would be around $1,700, but with today's deal you save nearly $250 instantly.

As we've previously mentioned, we haven't seen discounts on the all-new Bose Lifestyle lineup beyond these sets:

  • Bose Surround Sound Set $1,499 (originally $1,697) 1 Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar plus 2 Lifestyle Ultra speakers
  • Bose Stereo Music Set $529 (originally $498) 2 Lifestyle Ultra speakers

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • ASUS's new 27-inch ProArt 4K 240Hz QD-OLED professional monitor hits new low with $300 off
  • UGREEN NeoDrive Go 1TB USB4 SSD with built-in 40Gb/s cable hits new low $300 (originally $500)
  • This foldable aluminum laptop stand for your tech organizer only $15.50 (save 43%)
  • This 140W 4-port charger can power all your devices from a single outlet, today only $35 (41% off)
  • This 250W Anker Prime charging station with LCD screen can replace six chargers, new low $95
  • UGREEN's 14th Anniversary Sale officially kicks off: from $7, buy one get one half off, new lows and more
  • Ongoing: Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger drops to Prime Day price (33% off), from $8
  • Anker 10-port flat plug power strip on Amazon drops to $20
  • Philips Hue 4-bulb starter kit with Hue Bridge now same price as 2-bulb kit $80, new low
  • Use this Aiper 5-in-1 solar HydroComm smart pool monitor with two optimization tips to replace your test kit, better than $270 (save $90)
  • Use this set of 8 Govee Matter-ready cylinder lights to line your pathways, drops to $136
  • Twelve South vegan leather-wrapped PowerCapsule MagSafe power bank hits new low $35 on Amazon
  • Add this leather Apple Watch band to your rotation, Prime members get free shipping from $12 (40% off)

Rare Apple keyboard and black Magic Mouse deals (somehow still in stock) continue, new low from $80

We've certainly seen plenty of deals on Apple's main products — AirPods Pro 3 for $50 off, the largest Apple Watch Series 11 models now up to $130 off — but Magic accessories are indeed rarer. However (for some reason), Amazon still has discounts from the previous Prime Day, including the full-size model of the basic Magic Keyboard with Touch ID, as well as the black Apple Magic Mouse.

These Apple accessory deals were really rare before the previously extended Prime Day discounts, and it's hard to say how long these deals will last.

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID $145 (originally $179)

All three are the lowest prices Amazon has tracked. It's been a long time since we've seen the black Apple Magic Mouse at this price (I personally want to buy a spare), and both Magic Keyboard models are at historic lows — the basic model has only dropped this low once before, and the Touch ID version has never gone below $158.

If you're looking to swap out your Apple Magic input devices, now is the best time to take advantage while Prime Day prices are still in stock.

Nomad's major site-wide anniversary sale officially kicks off: rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, Watch bands and more

Nomad has just kicked off one of their biggest promotional events of the year, covering deals on iPhone 17 leather cases, Apple Watch bands, cables, Find My tracker cards (we received word that it launches today, but haven't seen it yet), their sleek Stand One Max 3-in-1 25W MagSafe charger wallets, and more. Combined with all the deals in the Overstock Sale section, some of their newest products are up to 30% off, and there are also rare official cash discounts on multiple items.

Nomad Anniversary Sale

The Nomad Anniversary Sale is one of their biggest annual discount events. Although the official website has discounts from time to time, we're talking about a brand that didn't participate in Prime Day at all this year and doesn't hold big sales every holiday like other accessory brands.

If you've been keeping an eye on this brand's products, now is the time to buy. The Nomad Anniversary Sale runs from today until July 20, but if it follows the pattern of their previous major promotions, the most popular items could sell out at any time.

Here's a quick rundown of the key deals this time, along with some rare direct cash discounts on products:

Leather Mag Wallet — 20% off

Titanium Apple Watch Stratos Band — 20% off

Apple Watch Sport Bands — 25% off

Stand One 25W MagSafe Charger — 20% off

Stand One Max 3-in-1 25W MagSafe Charger — 20% off

Leather Mag Wallet Find My Tracking — 10% off

Nomad ChargeKey — 20% off

iPhone 17 Magnetic Leather Back — 30% off

Apple Watch Universal Cable — 20% off

Nomad's sleek metal and glass 25W Qi2 MagSafe stand is rarely 20% off

Nomad's Titanium Stratos Apple Watch band is rarely 20% off during the Anniversary Sale
